result.sql: WITH orders AS (SELECT orders_current.region AS region, orders_current.paid_amount AS paid_amount, TRY_CAST(orders_current.order_date AS DATE) AS order_date FROM orders_current UNION ALL SELECT orders_history.region AS region, orders_history.paid_amount AS paid_amount, TRY_CAST(orders_history.order_date AS DATE) AS order_date FROM orders_history) SELECT region AS "地区", SUM(paid_amount) AS "实付金额合计" FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2027-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2027-09-01' GROUP BY region ORDER BY region LIMIT 200
